Daldo Marte Limonta (Havana, 1982) is a young Cuban artist who has performed the role of superhero for more than a decade. He is a tireless creator, and his obsession is to find a space in the world, which has presented itself as alien since his childhood. The means and resources he uses to reach his objective, employing art, evince an inventive and extraordinary aesthetic sensibility.


Heroism, as a general notion, is a question of perspective and is intimately linked to the attitude that the protagonist of the action has toward life. The sense of justice, the beliefs, and the overcoming of fears motivated by adverse situations play a decisive role in the quality and appreciation of a hero. Daldo Marte, without having had applied studies or any other training linked to art, has achieved these purposes with an unprecedented artistic endeavor. Making use of his intuition and a particular common sense, he has constructed a small, marvelous story that accrues form day after day, transcending the physical borders of his neighborhood, the city, and the country.
